positions.name: Sprint4DeliveryOutcomes
positions.frame: what did Sprint 4 deliver and what enabled the delivery?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere under a single directional read of Sprint 4's delivery story: what shipped (the async decision widget), what velocity it achieved (23 points, highest this quarter), and what technical enabler unlocked it (Zephyr integration). The set holds no internal tension — each expression answers a different facet of the same delivery-outcomes question.
